_readme: Single source for the About page team grid. Array order = display order. Edit here, then run: python _team/build_team.py. Set "hidden": true to keep someone's data without showing them. focal = CSS object-position for the 4:5 crop. bio = paragraphs, rendered verbatim.

members.name: H. Frederick Bowman
members.title: President, CEO & Chairman
bio: Dr. Bowman is the inventor of the Company's technology and the founder of Hemedex. He concurrently served as the Senior Academic Administrator of the Harvard-MIT Division of Health Sciences and Technology for 40 years through September 2010. He served as a member of the Mechanical and Biomedical Engineering faculties at Northeastern University for 25 years, as a lecturer on Radiation Oncology at Harvard Medical School, and as Program Director for Biomedical Engineering at the National Science Foundation.

Dr. Bowman has a B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering from Pennsylvania State University and M.S. and Ph.D. degrees from MIT in Nuclear Engineering. He is the author of some 120 publications and abstracts, holds 20 patents and is a Fellow of the American Institute of Medical and Biological Engineers.

members.name: Charles J. Welch
members.title: Chief Technical Officer
bio: Mr. Welch joined the parent company of Hemedex, Inc. – Thermal Technologies Incorporated (TTI) – in 1991. Along with Dr. Bowman, he is one of the principal developers of the Bowman Perfusion Monitoring (BPM) system and is currently responsible for Hardware Design and Software Testing. He is a significant contributor to the Customer Service and Clinical Support roles of the company.

Since the inception of the Thermal Diffusion-based technology, he has been instrumental in the research and development of the QFlow500™ Perfusion Probe, the BPM, and the calibration and manufacturing processes. He has extensive experience in the development of medical and technical instrumentation.

members.name: James L. Neal
members.title: Chief Legal Counsel & Board Member

bio: Mr. Neal is an experienced attorney in corporate, commercial and patent law. He has 15 years of experience serving as Chief Legal Counsel for a major technology company and 8 years of experience in private practice. He is a co-founder of Hemedex where he oversees the development of intellectual property and legal affairs.
Mr. Neal has a B.S. degree in Civil Engineering from North Carolina State University and a Juris Doctorate (Law) from American University in Washington, D.C.

members.name: Deanna Bowman
members.title: Senior Director of Manufacturing
members.todo: TODO: new photo expected (not yet received). Showing initials avatar until then.
bio: Deanna Bowman brings more than three decades of experience in precision manufacturing, research and development, product fabrication, and production leadership across medical technology, electronics, and defense-related applications. Earlier in her career, Deanna served as a Production Manager at Raytheon, where she supervised manufacturing personnel responsible for producing subassemblies used in the Sparrow missile guidance system and held clearance to support federal government contracts.

Throughout her career, Deanna has worked closely with design engineers to translate complex technical requirements into practical manufacturing processes. Her experience includes prototyping, probe production and calibration, precision device fabrication, production planning, and supervision of manufacturing teams ranging from 10 to 50 employees.

As Senior Director of Manufacturing at Hemedex, Deanna leads manufacturing activities supporting the company’s cerebral perfusion monitoring technologies, cranial bolts, and related accessories. Her extensive knowledge of precision probe manufacturing and hands-on production operations contributes to the consistent manufacture of Hemedex products and supports the company’s commitment to quality and reliability.

members.name: Timothé F. Martin
members.title: Director of Regulatory Affairs/Quality Assurance & Operations
bio: Timothé Martin, Director of Operations & QA/RA, joined Hemedex in 2022. He effectively oversees manufacturing processes, manages facility and inventory records, and supports the management team in marketing and educating stakeholders/customers on the scientific aspects of Hemedex projects and products.

With a track record of successfully developing and executing regulatory strategies for product and company registrations, Tim has demonstrated leadership in overseeing FDA, EU, and ISO surveillance audits without any findings. Timothé graduated cum laude from the University of Massachusetts – Lowell with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Biology, specializing in Biotechnology, and a minor in Business Administration.

members.name: Daniel J. DeRienzo
members.title: Director of Customer Operations and Logistics
bio: Daniel DeRienzo joined Hemedex in 2022. As a Client Services Manager, he works to maximize quality and efficiency of manufacturing processes, promote quality system improvements, manage customer relations, and drive sales and marketing efforts to reach new audiences.

Before joining Hemedex, Daniel worked in business management at Enterprise Holdings where he was responsible for overseeing and optimizing operations. Daniel attended the University of New Hampshire where he earned his Bachelor's degree in Business Communication.

members.name: Stefanie Cantin
members.title: Strategic Advisor, Product Development & Commercialization
bio: Stefanie Cantin brings more than 15 years of leadership experience across commercial medical devices and clinical-stage biotechnology. She previously spent 10 years with Hemedex, advancing through four progressively responsible roles and ultimately serving as Vice President and Management Representative. During her tenure, she held executive responsibility for the company’s Quality Management System and regulatory compliance while contributing to product development, manufacturing, operations, customer support, marketing, and commercialization.

Most recently, Stefanie served as Senior Director of Operations and Interim Quality Assurance at Privo Technologies, a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing innovative oncology therapies. Her responsibilities spanned clinical development, quality and CMC oversight, FDA regulatory support, business development, government-funded research programs, and corporate operations. She supported 38 IND sequence submissions, five formal FDA meeting preparations, a multi-site oncology master protocol, and approximately $9 million in non-dilutive National Cancer Institute funding. She also helped guide product and portfolio strategy, strategic partnerships, scientific communications, and Phase 3 readiness activities.

As Strategic Advisor, Product Development & Commercialization, Stefanie applies this cross-functional experience to support Hemedex’s product strategy, regulatory and quality planning, development programs, commercial initiatives, and strategic growth.
Stefanie holds a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science with a minor in Criminal Justice from Western New England University.

members.name: Mack Lund
members.title: Board of Directors
bio: Mack has held various technology and business leadership roles in the electronics industry. At Analog Devices (ADI), he was Product and Technology Director for the Interface and Isolation Technology Group and held other roles leading technology strategy, system engineering, engineering management, and product marketing.

Mack holds MBA and MSEE degrees from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, a MEng in Electric Power Engineering from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, and a BSEE from Brigham Young University. Mack is a Senior Member of the IEEE and a registered professional engineer.

members.name: Rick Tardiff
members.title: Board of Directors
bio: Rick Tardiff served as Gray, Gray & Gray's International Business Partner, leading efforts to collaborate with chartered accountants and CPA firms in Latin America. He served the audit and tax needs of a wide range of businesses and their owners for over 30 years.

Rick is a graduate of New Mexico State University with a degree in accounting. He is a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the Massachusetts Society of Certified Public Accountants.

members.name: Tracey M. Berlin
members.title: MSN-Ed, RN, CNRN, CCRN — Consultant, Clinical Applications Specialist

bio: Mrs. Berlin has 29 years of experience in neuroscience nursing, serving in roles of staff nurse, management, education, and research. Prior to joining the Hemedex team, she was employed as the Unit Educator and Neuroscience Technology Specialist in a busy Neuro ICU where she became a champion for multimodal monitoring with the Bowman Perfusion Monitor.
As Clinical Applications Specialist, Tracey supports new and existing customers with training, clinical integration, and education on cerebral perfusion monitoring best practices.
